title.narrative: Climate Resilience & Green Livelihood Consortium – Led by JDPC Abuja. CWSI, Big Family 360 & YASIF

description.narrative:
The JDPC Abuja–led consortium project, implemented in partnership with CWSI, Big Family 360, and YASIF, aims to strengthen climate resilience and promote sustainable green livelihoods in two climate-affected communities in Kuje Area Council, FCT Abuja. The project targets 3,000 vulnerable urban and peri-urban households, with intentional inclusion of women-led households, youth, and persons with disabilities (PWDs).
Communities in Kuje are increasingly exposed to flooding, heat stress, erratic rainfall, and environmental degradation, which threaten livelihoods, food security, public health, and household income stability. Many households rely on fragile income sources, have limited access to skills development and finance, and lack preparedness mechanisms to withstand climate-related shocks.
To address these challenges, the project integrates climate-smart livelihood diversification with community-based disaster risk reduction (DRR) and environmental protection. Under the livelihoods component, 200 households will receive climate-smart agriculture support, while 600 households will benefit from green off-farm vocational training in renewable energy briquette production and solar installation, combined with mentorship, enterprise development, startup support, and financial literacy training. The project will also facilitate the formation of savings groups, cooperatives, and market linkages, while advocating for inclusive green finance and policy engagement at local and state levels.
To strengthen community resilience, Disaster Risk Reduction Committees (CDRRCs) will be established and trained, community DRR plans developed, and early warning coordination enhanced through partnerships with relevant institutions. Environmental actions will include waste sorting and upcycling training, tree planting, ecosystem restoration, rainwater harvesting, and climate-resilient sanitation and hygiene promotion.
